current.title: Khaak Ka Raja
current.logline: Paanch saal pehle, Arjun ko uski hi biwi aur best friend ne milkar dhoka diya, uski saari daulat chheen li, aur use marne ke liye chhod diya. Ab woh laut aaya hai — na sirf pehchaan badal kar, balki sheher ke sabse bade businessman ke roop mein — aur ab uska ek hi maqsad hai: un sab ko barbaad karna jinhone uski zindagi tabaah ki thi.

Arjun Singh / Aaryan Malhotra.role: Betrayed ex-husband, now a powerful, mysterious business magnate.
Arjun Singh / Aaryan Malhotra.secret: He is Arjun Singh, alive and back for revenge.
Arjun Singh / Aaryan Malhotra.want: To systematically destroy Nisha and Rahul, reclaiming his honour and everything they stole.

Nisha Malhotra.role: Arjun's ex-wife, now living a lavish life built on his stolen wealth.
Nisha Malhotra.secret: She conspired with Rahul to betray Arjun, believing him dead.
Nisha Malhotra.want: To maintain her opulent lifestyle and solidify her social standing, unaware of Aaryan's true identity.

Rahul Khanna.role: Arjun's former best friend, now Nisha's husband and business partner.
Rahul Khanna.secret: He orchestrated Arjun's downfall and left him for dead.
Rahul Khanna.want: To consolidate his power and wealth, ensure Arjun's past remains buried.

arc: Part 1: Shaadi ke 6 mahine baad, Arjun ke accounts khaali the. Jis best friend Rahul ko usne apna business partner banaya tha, aur jis biwi Nisha ko apni jaan maana tha, unhone uski saari daulat chheen kar use pahadi se dhakka de diya. 'Ab tumhara khel khatam, Arjun,' Nisha ne muskurate hue kaha. 'Hamari nayi zindagi ab shuru hogi.' Arjun ki aankhon ke saamne andhera chha gaya. Paanch saal baad... Mumbai ke sabse bade charity gala mein entry hui Mr. Aaryan Malhotra ki. Poora hall unke naam se goonj utha. Nisha ne Mr. Malhotra ki taraf dekha, woh ek naye, taaqatwar shakhsiyat the. Woh unse milne aage badhi, uske chehre par ek meethi si muskaan thi. 'Welcome to Mumbai, Mr. Malhotra,' usne apna haath badhaya. Aaryan ne uske haath ko halke se pakda. 'Thank you, Mrs. Malhotra,' usne dheere se kaha, 'ya main tumhe Nisha bula sakoon?' Nisha ki muskaan ek pal ke liye thehar gayi. Rahul ne gusse se Aaryan ko dekha. Aaryan ne muskurate hue Nisha ki taraf dekha, 'Beginnings, Mrs. Malhotra,' usne correction kiya, 'or... endings?' Nisha ka chehra safed pad gaya.

Part 2: Aaryan Malhotra ne Rahul ki sabse badi competitor company ko hostile takeover kar liya tha. Rahul aur Nisha pareshan the. Unhone Aaryan se meeting maangi, jo Aaryan ne bahut der se di. 'Mujhe is company mein nivesh karna hai,' Aaryan ne ek file unki taraf badha di. 'Lekin shart yeh hai, Mr. Khanna, ki aap iski valuation se aadhe daam mein mujhe shares becho.' Rahul ki saans ruk gayi. 'Yeh toh cheating hai!' Nisha chillai. Aaryan ke chehre par ek bhi expression nahi tha. 'Deal pasand nahi? Toh aapka business aaj raat 12 baje tak bankruptcy declare kar dega.' Rahul ke haath kaanp rahe the. Uski saari daulat, uski saari mehnat, ek pal mein khatam ho sakti thi. Rahul ne thuk nigla, uske maathe par paseena tha. Usne kalam uthayi, aur papers par sign kar diya. Aaryan uske kareeb aaya. 'Remember this feeling, Mr. Khanna,' usne dheere se kaha. Rahul ne upar dekha, uski aankhon mein ghabrahat thi. 'Tumhari aankhein...' usne kaanpte hue kaha, 'bilkul Arjun jaisi hain.' Aaryan ke hothon par halki si muskaan thehar gayi.

Part 3: Rahul ko Aaryan ki aankhon mein Arjun ki jhalak dikhti thi, lekin uske har investigation mein Aaryan ka koi connection Arjun se nahi mila. Woh pareshan tha, Nisha uspar hans rahi thi. 'Kahan Raja Bhoj, kahan Gangoo Teli, Rahul. Arjun toh mar chuka hai.' Lekin tabhi Nisha ke bank accounts freeze hone lage. Uski luxury car, uske expensive handbags, sab repossessed ho gaye. Woh ghabra kar Aaryan ke office pahunchi. 'Yeh kya ho raha hai, Mr. Malhotra? Tum meri zindagi barbaad kyun kar rahe ho?' Aaryan apni chair par baitha tha, aankhon mein thandi chamak. 'Maine ek deal offer ki hai, Mrs. Malhotra,' usne kaha. 'Agar tum yeh deal maanti ho, toh main tumhara sab kuch bacha sakta hoon.' 'Kaisi deal?' Nisha ne kaanpte hue poocha. 'Tumhein kal ek press conference mein publicly maafi maangni hogi,' Aaryan ne ek statement uski taraf badhaya. 'Us insaan se jise tumne sabse zyada hurt kiya hai.' Nisha ne gusse se us statement ko dekha. Agle din, press conference shuru hui. Nisha stage par khadi thi, uski aankhon mein aansu the. Usne mic pakda, uski aawaaz kaanp rahi thi. 'Mujhe maaf kar do,' usne chokte hue kaha. Camera flashes ki roshni mein, Aaryan hall ke pichhe khada tha, uske chehre par ek gehra santushti ka bhaav tha.

Part 4: Nisha ki public humiliation ne use andar tak tod diya tha. Rahul uspar chillaya. 'Tumne meri izzat bhi mitti mein mila di!' Nisha ne uski taraf dekha. 'Meri izzat? Tumne toh mera sab kuch chheen liya!' Rahul gusse mein Aaryan ki file khol kar baitha tha. Uski nazar ek choti si detail par padi – ek old college ID card ki photo mein Aaryan ne wahi shirt pehni thi jo Arjun ne ek baar usko birthday par gift ki thi. 'Yeh... yeh toh Arjun ki shirt thi,' Rahul ne apne dil ki dhadkan tez hoti mehsoos ki. Woh yeh baat Nisha ko batane hi wala tha ki TV par breaking news flash hui: 'Aaryan Malhotra ne announce kiya apna naya mega-project, 'Phoenix Towers'.' Screen par project ka blueprint dikha. Nisha ki saans ruk gayi. Uski aankhein badi ho gayi. 'Yeh toh Arjun ka design tha... bilkul wahi blueprint!' Usne Rahul ki taraf dekha, uske chehre par darr chha gaya. Tabhi Rahul ka phone baja. Screen par 'Aaryan Malhotra' chamak raha tha. 'Rahul, ek choti si board meeting hai,' Aaryan ki awaaz bilkul saant thi, 'meri nayi company ke liye... jise maine tumhare purane project ke theek saamne banaya hai.'

Part 5: Nisha aur Rahul poori tarah se darr chuke the. Unhein yakeen ho chuka tha ki Aaryan Malhotra hi Arjun Singh hai. Unhone Aaryan ko rokne ke liye har mumkin koshish ki, lekin har taraf se unhein naakaami mili. Aaryan ne Rahul ki poori company ko merge karne ke liye ek emergency board meeting bulayi. Meeting hall mein jab Aaryan aaya, toh Rahul aur Nisha ke chehre par paseena tha. Aaryan ne unhein dekha, uski aankhon mein ek purani shaitani chamak thi. 'Kya hua, Mr. Khanna, Mrs. Malhotra?' usne dheere se kaha, uski awaaz mein Arjun ki pehchan saaf thi. 'Mujhe pehchana nahi? Main Arjun Singh.' Rahul ki aankhein badi ho gayi. Nisha ne apne muh par haath rakh liya, uska shareer kaanp raha tha. Aaryan ne ek projector on kiya. Screen par wahi CCTV footage chal rahi thi jab Rahul aur Nisha ne Arjun ko dhakka diya tha. Nisha ki cheekh nikal gayi. Rahul gusse se Aaryan par jhapta, 'Tum zinda kaise ho sakte ho!' Aaryan ke bodyguards ne use rok liya. Aaryan ne muskurate hue Nisha ki taraf dekha. 'Ab asli hisaab hoga, Nisha. Tumhe kya laga... main mar gaya?'

Part 6: Poore sheher mein khabar phail gayi. Rahul aur Nisha ka fraud sabke saamne aa chuka tha. Unki saari properties, unki saari companies, sab Aaryan ne apne kabze mein le li thi. Unhein har taraf se nikal diya gaya. Woh apni mansion mein baithi thi, jo ab bank ne seize kar li thi. Nisha ro rahi thi, Rahul sar pakad kar zameen par baitha tha. Police sirens ki awaaz sunayi di. Darwaza khula, aur do police officers andar aaye. 'Mr. Rahul Khanna aur Mrs. Nisha Malhotra? Aapko hamare saath chalna hoga.' Unhein handcuff kiya ja raha tha. Nisha ne cheekh kar Rahul ki taraf dekha. 'Yeh sab tumhari wajah se hua hai!' Rahul ne use gusse se dekha. 'Mujhse zyada tum zimmedar ho!' Police unhein bahar le ja rahi thi. Mansion ke gate par, Arjun khada tha. Usne Nisha aur Rahul ko dekha. Nisha ki aankhon mein nafrat thi. 'Arjun! Tumhe kabhi maaf nahi karungi!' woh chillai. Arjun ne bas apna sar hilaya, uske chehre par ek dard bhari muskaan thi. Usne apni jeb se ek chhota sa, tarnished silver locket nikala, wahi jo Nisha ne uski shadi par diya tha. Usne locket ko apni mutthi mein bhheench liya, uska chehra kathor ho gaya. 'Maafi toh tumhein khud se mangni chahiye thi, Nisha,' usne dheere se kaha, 'jab tumne mere pyaar ka gala ghonta tha.'
current.soFar: Shaadi ke 6 mahine baad, Arjun Singh ko uski biwi Nisha aur uske best friend Rahul ne dhoka diya, uski saari daulat chheen li, aur use marne ke liye pahadi se dhakka de diya. Paanch saal baad, Arjun ek naye naam aur pehchaan ke saath Mr. Aaryan Malhotra ke roop mein wapas aaya hai. Usne Mumbai ke charity gala mein Nisha aur Rahul se mulaqat ki, jahan usne unhein apne iraade saaf kar diye. Ab, Aaryan ne Rahul ki sabse badi competitor company ka hostile takeover kar liya hai. Usne Rahul aur Nisha ko ek aisi deal offer ki jahan unhein apni company ke shares aadhe daam mein bechne honge, ya phir unka business aaj raat tak bankruptcy declare kar dega. Majboori mein, Rahul ne papers par sign kar diya. Lekin is process mein, usne Aaryan ki aankhon mein Arjun ki jhalak dekh li, jisse woh buri tarah ghabra gaya.
